    Lou Wong Bean Sprout Chicken

    Ipoh's iconic tauge ayam since 1957 — poached chicken, blanched bean sprouts and smooth hor fun. Anthony Bourdain ate here; still open, moving to a bigger site in 2026.

How we choose

Every place is recommended by named sources (review-aggregator star ratings never count as the recommender), pinned to its door from a published coordinate, and status-checked. Closed places stay, flagged, so you know they’re gone.

How this guide was made

Web-searched & fact-checked

Every place is traceable to a credible source — Michelin, UNESCO, local news & magazines, and vetted local/viral creators — in data/sources.json. Coordinates are verified into data/geocodes.json and every place status-checked open. Yelp/TripAdvisor never count toward the two-source bar.
